description: This file contains unit tests for WebSocket JSON communication within the WPEFramework project. It defines classes for message handling, WebSocket server and client wrappers, and a test case that verifies JSON message exchange over WebSocket connections.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a JSON message with 'eventType' and 'event' fields, used for WebSocket communication testing.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: A pool of Message objects used to generate JSON elements for WebSocket communication.

classes.name: JsonSocketServer
classes.description: A WebSocket server wrapper that handles JSON messages, manages connection state, and synchronization for testing.

classes.name: JsonSocketClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client wrapper that sends and receives JSON messages, used in the test case.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes in the WebSocket server, signals when the server is open.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Processes incoming JSON messages on the server side.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends JSON messages from the server side (empty implementation).

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns whether the server has reached the 'done' state.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Processes incoming JSON messages on the client side, stores received data.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends JSON messages from the client side (empty implementation).

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the last received message on the client side.
